messages.subject: number of breaks
parts:
Hello,

I want to do free scales, but is it possible when I dont know a number
of breaks to control labels?
For example I want to print all the breaks but only 3 labels: for the
first, middle and last break.

Is it possible to know for each graphic a number of breaks when it is
free scale?

opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size = 15, face = "plain",
colour = "black",angle=90, hjust=0)) +
opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size = 15, face = "plain",
